title: eval-harness: add CI hook for per-prompt regression checks and metrics integration
author: Priya Patel
description: Add a new CI hook that runs the eval-harness per-prompt regression checks and pushes key eval metrics into the CI pipeline for quality gating. Motivation: prevent prompt-set regressions from leaking into main by gating merges on per-prompt accuracy/coverage thresholds and exposing model-level metrics in PRs for reviewer visibility. Implementation includes a GitHub Action (eval-harness-ci.yml) that runs lightweight evals on changed prompt-sets, a metrics uploader that reports to the existing CI metrics ingestion endpoint, and a feature flag to opt-out for large changes. Also includes integration tests and documentation updates. This PR bundles the CI workflow, a small refactor to the eval runner to support timeout/config overrides, and a quality-gating script that fails the job when thresholds are violated. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and docs updates.

review_comments: Alex Johnson: Nice work. Two high-level asks: 1) make the gating thresholds configurable via repo-level config, 2) ensure this is fast by default (timeout defaults should be conservative).
Priya Patel: Thanks — added repo config support (.eval-ci.yml) and lowered defaults; added comments in runner.py to explain tradeoffs.
Marco Ruiz: Can we avoid flaky signal from the small prompt-sets? Suggest adding a rerun-with-bigger-sample step on borderline failures.
Priya Patel: Added a 'rerun-on-borderline' flag to the action; the action now attempts one larger sample rerun before failing the PR. Rerun is opt-in and capped to avoid long CI time.
Emily Chen: Integration tests look good. Please add one test that simulates a metric regression and ensures the job fails.
Priya Patel: Added test_ci_runner.py case that injects a failing metric and asserts non-zero exit; CI green locally.
merge_details: Squash-merged after approvals. Rollout gated behind a feature flag and will be enabled for infra teams first. Metrics ingestion keys provisioned via CI secrets.
release_notes: Add CI hook for eval-harness that performs per-prompt regression checks and exports eval metrics to CI for gating. Default run is conservative and opt-in via .eval-ci.yml. See docs/ops/ci-eval-gating.md for configuration and rollout steps.
notes_for_qa: QA: exercise CI workflow by opening a branch that changes a prompt-set and confirm that the eval-harness job runs and that gating triggers on a synthetic regression. Follow docs/ops/ci-eval-gating.md for test steps.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: CI runtime increase and false positives on small prompt-sets. Mitigation: conservative timeouts, rerun-on-borderline, opt-in config, and rollout behind feature flag.
additional_context: Related: this work unblocks ENG-2145 (per-prompt alerting) and PM-1021 (quality gating for public infra). We coordinated with CI infra to reserve a short-lived runner and with security to ensure metrics keys are scoped.
rollback_plan: Disable the GH Action and revert the feature flag; metrics uploader has no destructive behavior. Documented rollback steps in docs/ops/ci-eval-gating.md.
changelog_entry: 2025-01-15: CI: eval-harness per-prompt regression checks and metrics integration (feature-flagged).
